title: ERP connector touchpoints
summary: Implement IHasConnectorIntegration and mark methods with [ConnectorTouchPoint] (scheduled) or [ConnectorTouchPoint(Type = "RealTime")] (called during the shopper's request).
when_to_use: inventory, price or order synchronization with an ERP
not_for: generic data import/export files (use data exchange processors)
limitations: Real-time touchpoints sit in the shopper's request path: latency and failure handling are your responsibility
platform_change_if: a data flow the connector model cannot express

unverified: the full touchpoint catalogue and request/response models
